We are &nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Ads / Performance Marketing Specialist
Job Location: Enugu
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	Are you a data-driven performance marketer with a proven track record of creating and scaling high-performing paid &nbsp;advertising campaigns?
	We are looking for an experienced Paid Ads &amp; Performance Marketing Expert who has mastered paid media across multiple platforms and can demonstrate measurable results from previous campaigns.


Key Responsibilities


	Plan, execute, and optimize high-performing paid advertising campaigns.
	Develop and manage multi-platform advertising strategies to drive leads, sales, and brand growth.
	Monitor campaign performance, analyze data, and continuously improve ROI.
	Conduct audience research, A/B testing, and conversion optimization.
	Manage advertising budgets effectively while maximizing campaign performance.
	Stay up to date with platform updates, AI advertising tools, and industry best practices.
	Work closely with the creative and marketing teams to develop high-converting campaigns.


Required Expertise:
Applicants must demonstrate strong expertise in:


	Instagram Ads (Expert)
	Facebook Ads (Expert)
	Google Ads &amp; Search Ads (Expert)
	TikTok Ads
	LinkedIn Ads
	Snapchat Ads
	AI-Powered Advertising Tools and Automation

	Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience managing paid advertising campaigns.
	Proven ability to generate measurable business results through paid media.
	Strong understanding of conversion tracking, analytics, audience targeting, and campaign optimization.
	Experience managing significant advertising budgets across multiple platforms.
	Excellent analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills.
	Ability to interpret campaign data and provide actionable recommendations.
	Strong communication and reporting skills.


Preferred Qualifications:


	Google Ads Certification or Meta Blueprint Certification is an added advantage.
	Experience with Google Analytics (GA4), Meta Business Suite, Google Tag Manager, and other analytics tools.
	Familiarity with AI-powered advertising and campaign automation platforms.

Ads / Performance Marketing Specialist Job at Havana Group




        
    

        
        Havana Group has a number of companies under its porfolio. We're into real estate, media, technology and hospitality. You will enjoy working with us if you're a talented young, vibrant, energetic, creativeand ambitious individual who wants to work with a team of other champions, in an environment that sponsors growth and development. If you're not intimidated with greatness, you're welcome to join our team.

We are  recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Ads / Performance Marketing Specialist
Job Location: Enugu
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	Are you a data-driven performance marketer with a proven track record of creating and scaling high-performing paid  advertising campaigns?
	We are looking for an experienced Paid Ads & Performance Marketing Expert who has mastered paid media across multiple platforms and can demonstrate measurable results from previous campaigns.


Key Responsibilities


	Plan, execute, and optimize high-performing paid advertising campaigns.
	Develop and manage multi-platform advertising strategies to drive leads, sales, and brand growth.
	Monitor campaign performance, analyze data, and continuously improve ROI.
	Conduct audience research, A/B testing, and conversion optimization.
	Manage advertising budgets effectively while maximizing campaign performance.
	Stay up to date with platform updates, AI advertising tools, and industry best practices.
	Work closely with the creative and marketing teams to develop high-converting campaigns.


Required Expertise:
Applicants must demonstrate strong expertise in:


	Instagram Ads (Expert)
	Facebook Ads (Expert)
	Google Ads & Search Ads (Expert)
	TikTok Ads
	LinkedIn Ads
	Snapchat Ads
	AI-Powered Advertising Tools and Automation


Requirements


	Minimum of 5 years of hands-on experience managing paid advertising campaigns.
	Proven ability to generate measurable business results through paid media.
	Strong understanding of conversion tracking, analytics, audience targeting, and campaign optimization.
	Experience managing significant advertising budgets across multiple platforms.
	Excellent analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills.
	Ability to interpret campaign data and provide actionable recommendations.
	Strong communication and reporting skills.


Preferred Qualifications:


	Google Ads Certification or Meta Blueprint Certification is an added advantage.
	Experience with Google Analytics (GA4), Meta Business Suite, Google Tag Manager, and other analytics tools.
	Familiarity with AI-powered advertising and campaign automation platforms.


Salary
N150,000 - N300,000 per month. 

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV, portfolio, and evidence of successful campaigns (including performance metrics or case studies where possible) to: [email protected] using "Application – Paid Ads & Performance Marketing Expert" as the subject of the email.

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Customer Relations Officer Job at O.Peenice Adio Global Enterprise




        
    

        
        O.Peenice Adio Global Enterprise, based in Lagos, Nigeria, is a registered business specializing in thesales, supply, and distribution of general goods, general merchandise, and general contracting services. Registered with the Corporate Affairs Commission (CAC), the enterprise operates in areas such as manufacturing, warehousing, and sales executive roles.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Customer Relations Officer

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description
     

            
    




	We are looking for a friendly, proactive, and customer-focused Customer Relations Officer to manage customer enquiries, maintain relationships, and ensure a positive customer experience.


Responsibilities


	Respond to customer enquiries through phone, WhatsApp, social media, and other channels.
	Follow up with customers and potential customers.
	Build and maintain strong customer relationships.
	Keep records of customer interactions and follow-ups.
	Encourage customer retention and repeat engagement.
	Gather customer feedback and share insights with management.


Requirements


	HND/Bachelor’s degree in any relevant field.
	0-1 year of experience in customer service, sales, or a related role.
	Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
	Friendly, patient, and professional attitude.
	Good use of WhatsApp, social media, and digital communication tools.
	Good organizational and follow-up skills.
	Must reside in Lagos State.
	Ability to work independently and as part of a team.


Salary
N150,000 - N200,000 monthly.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.
